part_description: Aluminium 6061 rectangular bracket, 150x100x25mm, four countersunk M6 holes, one central rectangular pocket 80x20x15mm deep, Ra 6.3 surface finish
retrieved_rules_used: CUTTING_PARAMS [aluminium_6061 + drilling]: For drilling of aluminium_6061 — cutting speed: 40-80 m/min, feed: 0.1-0.3 mm/rev, depth of cut: full_depth mm. Source: Machining Data Handbook, Table 4.4

CUTTING_PARAMS [aluminium_6061 + finish_turning]: For finish_turning of aluminium_6061 — cutting speed: 300-500 m/min, feed: 0.05-0.15 mm/rev, depth of cut: 0.1-0.3 mm. Source: Machining Data Handbook, Table 3.4

CUTTING_PARAMS [aluminium_6061 + rough_turning]: For rough_turning of aluminium_6061 — cutting speed: 200-400 m/min, feed: 0.2-0.4 mm/rev, depth of cut: 2-6 mm. Source: Machining Data Handbook, Table 3.4

TOLERANCE_RULE [H7]: For H7 tolerance, mandatory finishing operation is reaming or fine_boring. Typical Ra: 0.8-1.6 microns. Note: Reaming after drilling, or fine boring — standard bearing fit. Source: ISO 286-1:2010 — Geometrical product specifications

TOLERANCE_RULE [H8]: For H8 tolerance, mandatory finishing operation is semi_finish_turning or reaming. Typical Ra: 1.6-3.2 microns. Note: Fine turning acceptable — general sliding fit. Source: ISO 286-1:2010 — Geometrical product specifications

TOLERANCE_RULE [h6]: For h6 tolerance, mandatory finishing operation is cylindrical_grinding. Typical Ra: 0.4-0.8 microns. Note: Grinding mandatory — turning alone cannot achieve IT6. Source: ISO 286-1:2010 — Geometrical product specifications
SEQUENCING_RULE [priority 12]: Chamfering and deburring are always the final operations. Source: Machining Data Handbook, Ch.1
SEQUENCING_RULE [priority 3]: All semi-finish operations before finish operations. Source: Machining Data Handbook, Ch.1
SEQUENCING_RULE [priority 7]: Internal features (bores, holes, pockets) before external finishing operations. Source: Machining Data Handbook, Ch.1
FEATURE_RULE [rectangular_passage]: To machine rectangular_passage, perform these operations in order: drilling, boring. . Source: Machining Data Handbook

process_plan.purpose: to create a flat surface for subsequent operations
to create a pilot hole for through hole
to create a pilot hole for blind hole
to create a through hole with a larger diameter
to create a blind hole with a larger diameter
to create a rectangular external feature
to create a rectangular blind slot
to create a rectangular external feature
to finish the rectangular external feature
to achieve a surface finish of Ra 6.3

planning_notes: This process plan assumes a CNC milling machine and a CNC turning machine are available. The cutting parameters are based on the Machining Data Handbook and may need to be adjusted based on the specific machine and tooling used.
